query_plan.query: What was the combined area of the German states that were part of the DDR, measured in square kilometers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by state, sum the areas of all returned states to get the combined area.
steps.query: Return all states that were part of the DDR. Also return their area in square kilometers.

extra.sql_query: SELECT SUM(german_states.area_km2) AS combined_area FROM german_states WHERE german_states.name IN ('Brandenburg', 'Mecklenburg-Vorpommern', 'Sachsen', 'Sachsen-Anhalt', 'Thüringen')

s1.sql_query: SELECT german_states.german_state, german_states.area_km2, german_states.name FROM german_states WHERE german_states.name IN ('Brandenburg', 'Mecklenburg-Vorpommern', 'Sachsen', 'Sachsen-Anhalt', 'Thüringen')
